title: Representation Bias of Adolescents in AI: A Bilingual, Bicultural Study

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing static word embeddings using Single-Category Word Embedding Association Tests (SC-WEAT) to identify words uniquely associated with adolescents compared to children, adults, and older adults; and applying directed content analysis to generative language model prompt continuations to identify associations with social problems, violence, sexualization, and stereotypes.
